summary: Both backend TTS APIs and frontend Suara pembayaran flow tested end-to-end. 9/9 backend pytest cases passed and 24/24 frontend interaction checks passed on 390x844 mobile viewport. All 4 voice personas (putri, lilis, parjo, bagas) produce distinct cached audio; caching, 404, and 400 error paths behave correctly. Suara pembayaran screen shows all 4 voice cards, volume segments, toggles, intro/outro pick+record buttons, Preview Suara and Test pembayaran buttons work without crashes; test-payment inserts new transactions visible in Riwayat.

issues: Console warns: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use boxShadow.
Console warns: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents (Toast component in index.tsx uses <View pointerEvents="none">).

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop pointerEvents; migrate to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:222
Deprecated shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset in styles; migrate to boxShadow on web while keeping native compatibility. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:226-230

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (RN Web) and pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents on Toast in index.tsx.
No blocking issues detected for the Suara pembayaran feature.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend VOICE_MAP correctly distinguishes 4 personas -> distinct OpenAI voices, verified by distinct sha256 cache keys.
TTS response excludes MongoDB _id (only returns {url}); audio bytes returned as audio/mpeg with long-lived Cache-Control.
Default voice was correctly changed to 'putri'; parent state saves voice/intro/outro/volume/repeat to storage; announcePayment / previewAnnouncement wired via props.
paymentSound.ts uses expo-audio (not deprecated expo-av) — good.
playSegment tolerates missing didJustFinish via a maxMs cap, preventing infinite waits in web preview where audio may not play.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Backend TTS entries are cache documents inserted by pytest calls (test text: 'lima puluh ribu rupiah' and 'cache probe').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_tts.py — reuse for regression. Frontend was tested at 390x844. Audio playback in headless web preview cannot be aurally validated; interaction and no-crash paths confirmed. Two new transactions were appended to txs during testing (visible in Riwayat under 'Hari ini').
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Only two non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings noted.
